ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT (WITHCOVENANTSANDEASEMENTS) THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (with Covenants and Easements) (this “Agreement"), is made as of the 27"n day of June, 2011, by and between 11 WEST 51 REALTY LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at c/o Masterworks Development Corporation 49 West 45th Street, 8th Floor, New York, New York 10036 (hereinafter referred to as“Seller") and PREF 7 WEST 51ST STREET LLC, a New York limited liability company, having offices at c/o Fox Horan & Camerini LLP, 825 Third Avenue, New York, NY 10016 (hereinafter referred to as “Purchaser"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Seller is the owner in fee title of that certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City, County and State of New York, known as and by the street address 11 West 51st Street,New York, NewYork 10019,identified as Block 1267, Lots 1101, 1102, 1103 and 1104 (f/k/a Lot 26) on the Tax Map of the City of New York and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land being hereinafter referred to as “Seller's Land'"'; said buildings and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Seller's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter referred to as “Seller's Property") which Seller's Property has heretofore been established as a condominium named 11 West 51" Condominium (the “Condominium") pursuant to that certain Declaration for Condominium recorded in the New York County Recorder's Office in CRFN 2011000087851 on March 10, 2011, Seller being the declarant under the Declaration for Condominium and the current owner of all of the units in the Condominium; WHEREAS, Purchaser is the owner in fee title of that certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City, County and State of New York, known as and by the street address 7 West 51st Street,New York,New York 10019,identified as Block             x      Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part thereof, (said land with buildings and improvements thereupon being referred to herein as “Purchaser's Land"); WHEREAS, Purchaser intends to construct a new building upon all or a portion of Purchaser's Land (said new building, with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being hereinafter referred to as the “New Building"; Seller's Land and Purchaser's Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the “Parcels" and each individually as a “Parcel"); -1- DM2/2784474.3
